exec: // If server returns an error object, surface it
pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.eql("Thiết bị đã được đăng ký thành công");
pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.match(/(Đã broadcast|đã gửi push notification|đã gửi realtime notification)/i);
pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.match(/(Đã broadcast|đã gửi push notification|đã gửi realtime notification)/i);
pm.test('Order ID exists in response', function () { pm.expect(orderId).to.exist; });
if (!orderId) { throw new Error('Missing orderId: run Create Order For File Test before Upload File.'); }
if (!token) { throw new Error('Missing customer_token: run Login Customer before Upload File.'); }
throw new Error('Upload File must use multipart/form-data. Remove manual Content-Type: application/json.');
if (!orderId) { throw new Error('Missing orderId: run Create Order For File Test before Get Files By Order.'); }
pm.test('Files payload is an array', function () {
if (!fileId) { throw new Error('Missing fileId: run Upload File before Download File.'); }
if (!bookingId) { throw new Error('Missing bookingId: run Create Booking before Confirm Booking.'); }
